# fragua

> AI-native PCB design tool. One static Go binary that hosts a script API for an AI
> agent and a live browser UI for the human: schematic, footprint placement,
> auto-routing, DRC/ERC, and JLCPCB/PCBWay-ready Gerber + BOM + CPL packs. No KiCad,
> no FreeRouting, no shell-out to any external CAD tool.

Start the tool, then drive it over MCP or plain HTTP:

```sh
fragua init              # AGENTS.md, a Claude Code skill, a Cursor rule, .mcp.json
fragua mcp board.fragua  # MCP server on stdio + HTTP API + UI on 127.0.0.1:7878
fragua run board.fragua  # HTTP API + UI only
```

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://fragua.cloud/llms-full.txt): the agent guide plus the complete script verb reference. Read this one.
- [README](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/README.md): install, run, and drive it from an agent.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/agent/AGENTS.md): the onboarding guide `fragua init` writes into a project.
- [VISION.md](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/VISION.md): what the product is and its non-negotiables.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/ARCHITECTURE.md): packages and data flow.
- [rust-vs-go.md](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/docs/rust-vs-go.md): ePlace and topo are Go ports of rust 4e20ae0.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mentasystems/fragua/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): scope and house style.

## API

- `POST /script`: run script lines, `{"script":"outline 30 20\nstatus"}`, text/plain reply.
- `GET /help`: full verb reference. `GET /help?verb=route` for one verb.
- `GET /state`: JSON project snapshot. `GET /screenshot`: board SVG. `GET /events`: SSE.
- `POST /save`: write the .fragua project.
- MCP tools: `fragua_script`, `fragua_help`, `fragua_status`, `fragua_state`,
  `fragua_screenshot`, `fragua_save`, `fragua_drc`, `fragua_route`.
